notes: All 2,678 land use 11 lots in the 235 tracts with 10 or more shootings in 2019-2024 were classified by records; by type: {'private_idle': 1471, 'city_interim': 668, 'stalled': 281, 'active_development': 258}. No GreenThumb garden and no buyout parcel fell in these tracts (gardens are mostly land use 9). After the size limit of 510 m2, 1,705 private-idle or city-interim lots remained, fewer than the 2,500 at which the plan called for sampling, so NAIP was read for every one (and for the small stalled and active lots, for comparison). Of the small idle lots, NAIP 2022 classed {'vegetated': 720, 'bare_or_paved': 565, 'mixed': 396, 'not_read': 24}. Trial-like lots: 1,116 (owners: {'private': 717, 'city': 304, 'X': 76, 'O': 19}; boroughs: {'BK': 405, 'BX': 274, 'QN': 274, 'SI': 90, 'MN': 73}), 225,620 m2 in all. Without the imagery filter the count is 1,705; adding stalled lots gives 1,252. 388.0 shootings a year (2023-2025) fell within 300 m of a trial-like lot, of 855.3 citywide. At the trial's effects, greening all of them would prevent 26.4 (10.5 to 41.1) shootings a year, cleanup 35.7 (18.6 to 51.2); the intervals are the trial's only and leave out the doubt about transfer. At the trial's costs ($5 per m2, $0.50 per m2 a year) greening would cost about $1,128,102 and $112,810 a year. Two problems were found after the data were read. The shooting dataset (5ucz-vwe8) as fetched has its latitude and longitude columns swapped; the analysis swaps them back. BIS permits for new buildings end in May 2020, so recent development activity rests on DOB NOW foundation, earthwork and demolition permits and on new-building filings. An exploratory visual check of 40 random lot images found that 4 of the 18 lots the rule calls trial-like show a building roof or a maintained ball field, so the count may be about a fifth too high; the share would still lie in the registered range.
notes_referee: Referee rebuilt 1,087 of 2,678 (0.406) vs 1,116 (0.417): 42 lots with DOB NOW activity missed by the join. Confirmed stands under rule 1; share 0.31-0.41 under tested choices. Exploratory image check: 28 of 40 screened lots (70%, 55-82%) not vacant blighted land; trial-like share ~0.12, below the registered floor. Rule 9 not met (scripts committed with outcome).
